recipes.ensA: v8-306H3 = mean of three v8-in fine-tunes by us (seeds 0, 1, 2; each 600 steps x 16 tiles on PHerc1447 w058 + w060 team labels plus PHerc0306B machine labels from four cleared models on 26.7 cm2 of other surfaces outside the exclusion zone, as model A, with hard negatives: the loss weight of every labelled background pixel is 1 + 4 x the model's own ink probability there) (ckpt sha256 9a281284...7009, 5c2740c1...60ad, a294716b...8ce7), each at TTA 1; inference as v8-in base: 24 render layers 8..31 (window centred on layer 20) in stored order (asc), clip 200, 64 px tiles at stride 21 from (115, 694) admitted at >= 25 % CT coverage, fp16, Gaussian (+-3 sigma) stitch divided by the weight SUM (= version 5's v8g3 recipe, P3/m306/eval/code/render_leadA.py = v5 code/ink_v8.py --nsig 3)

ink.fusion: mean of per-model z-scores; each model z-scored over the on-sheet pixels of the context view

display.rule: d = clip((z - lo)/(hi - lo), 0, 1); lo = median, hi = p99.9 of fused z over the on-sheet pixels of the shown area (context); no threshold
display.pixel: pixel = bg*(1-d) + INK*d; bg = PAGE (no CT); off-sheet blue-grey

rows.method: row profile of displayed ink (d >= 0.5) inside the box, smoothed 0.6 mm, peaks >= 3 mm apart; ticks 1.6 mm below the row centre, in the side margins only
